description: Approved demo-only analytics vocabulary over OHS FHIR Data Pipes projections.

freshness.updateBehavior: An operator-triggered FULL FHIR_SEARCH run recreates the sink projections; only succeeded runs with a source watermark are current.

views.name: analytics.lab_result_fact_v1
views.grain: Exactly one row per FHIR Observation, with at most one Specimen matched by resource key.

columns.name: patient_id
columns.description: FHIR Patient reference key; an opaque demo identifier.

columns.name: receipt_to_release_minutes
columns.description: Elapsed minutes from Specimen.receivedTime to Observation.issued; null when either timestamp is absent.

columns.name: test_code_system
columns.description: Code system URI from the first OpenELIS-emitted test coding.

columns.name: test_code
columns.description: Code from the first OpenELIS-emitted test coding.

columns.name: test_name
columns.description: Display text from the first OpenELIS-emitted test coding.

columns.name: result_value
columns.description: Numeric FHIR Quantity value; do not aggregate across unlike units.

columns.name: result_unit
columns.description: FHIR Quantity display unit; the seed uses copies/mL.

columns.name: result_unit_system
columns.description: FHIR Quantity unit system URI when OpenELIS emits one.

columns.name: result_unit_code
columns.description: FHIR Quantity unit code when OpenELIS emits one.

terminology: The OpenELIS 3.2.1.x demo catalog's Viral Load test has no asserted LOINC code; test_code_system and test_code must be treated as source-local unless the emitted system URI says otherwise.
The seed resolves the OpenELIS test by stable GUID b50d156e-0f6f-40cd-921c-4e831602a623 and expects its configured unit to be copies/mL.
FHIR status values are preserved; finalized OpenELIS seed analyses are expected to emit final Observations.

freshness.updateBehavior: Operator-triggered FULL FHIR_SEARCH after explicit HAPI backfill; query provenance must carry run ID, source watermark, completion state, and observed lag.

examples.question: Show this demo patient's viral-load results over time.
examples.sql: SELECT observed_at, result_value, result_unit FROM analytics.lab_result_fact_v1 WHERE patient_id = :patient_id AND observed_at >= :start_at AND observed_at < :end_at ORDER BY observed_at

examples.question: Show viral load results since 2026-01-01 with value, unit, release date, and receipt-to-release time.
examples.sql: SELECT result_value, result_unit, issued_at, specimen_received_at, receipt_to_release_minutes FROM analytics.lab_result_fact_v1 WHERE observed_at >= :start_at ORDER BY observed_at LIMIT 100
